versions.changelog:
Battle Report Briefing v1.0.0

- Initial release: produce mobile-friendly, single-screen tactical battle briefings (with PNG visuals) for historical/military conflicts
- Features include: unique color themes per side, inline SVG army flags, four KPI cards, tactical summary (5 bullets + commander’s quote), compact command structure, and detailed multi-source citations (10+)
- Workflow outlined from multi-source research, HTML prototyping, automated Playwright screenshots to secure PNG delivery
- Includes design templates, color tables for major factions, sample markup for tactical summary, and a thorough pre-release checklist
- Known limitations and best practices clearly documented to ensure consistency and professional standards
